title: Agenomic Coding Session Event (agenomic.coding.event/v1)
description: Envelope of one event observed in a supervised coding-agent session (Claude Code, Codex). RFC 0013. Every envelope names its session in coding_session_id. Events are delivered at least once and deduplicated on (coding_session_id, event_id) and on (coding_session_id, source, producer_epoch, producer_seq). The receiver's ingestion cursor is the session's read order, across all sources and epochs; events a receiver serves carry it as cursor, with received_at, both receiver-assigned and never sent by producers. producer_seq is a producer-side sequence within (source, producer_epoch) that consumers may use to recover emission order or detect gaps within that pair; receivers need not reorder by it, and the cursor order stands. producer_epoch is opaque and epochs are not ordered by value. A request, a decision, an observed start and an observed result are distinct facts carried by distinct events: an allow decision is not proof of execution. Every tool.requested, tool.started, tool.completed and tool.failed event carries the tool-call correlation key (coding_session_id, payload.native_request_id, attempt_id), which matches the coding action's (coding_session_id, native_request_id, attempt). Content fields inside payload (text, command, diff, output) appear only when the session's capture settings allow them and are redacted by the producer before export.

event_id.description: ULID (Crockford base32, 26 characters). Re-delivering the same event_id is a no-op.

coding_session_id.description: Id of the Agenomic coding session (coding-session.schema.json `id`) the event belongs to. Scopes deduplication and the tool-call correlation key. Producers always set it; stored and served events carry it exactly once.

source.description: Component that produced the event. runtime: the coding agent itself (native hook or SDK message); adapter: the connector adapter translating native signals; gateway: the Agenomic gateway (decisions, approvals); supervisor: the connector process supervisor (spawn, exit, heartbeat loss); filesystem: workspace observation (file and diff snapshots).

trust.description: native: reported by the runtime's own documented interface; derived: computed by the adapter from native signals; observed: inferred from outside the runtime (process table, filesystem, git). Consumers MUST NOT treat derived or observed facts as native.

producer_epoch.description: Opaque identifier of one producer lifetime (typically the connector boot ULID). producer_seq restarts when the epoch changes. Consumers MUST NOT order epochs by comparing their values; the receiver's ingestion cursor is the session's read order.

producer_seq.description: Strictly increasing sequence number of this event within (source, producer_epoch). It gives emission order (and gap detection) only within that pair, never across epochs or sources; it is not the read order, which is the receiver's ingestion cursor, and receivers need not reorder events by it.

cursor.description: Receiver-assigned: the opaque ingestion cursor of the stored event, present on events a receiver serves (APIs, streams, exports) and the position consumers page from. Producers MUST NOT send it; a receiver MUST either reject an ingested event that carries it or discard the producer-supplied value, and assigns its own. Consumers MUST treat it as opaque and MUST NOT compare or parse it.

received_at.description: Receiver-assigned: when the receiver stored the event, present on served events. Producers MUST NOT send it; a receiver MUST either reject an ingested event that carries it or discard the producer-supplied value, and sets its own. Informative only, like occurred_at: it MUST NOT be used to reorder events.

action_id.description: Links the event to an Agenomic coding action (coding-action.schema.json). Required on tool.requested. On tool.started, tool.completed and tool.failed it is set whenever a coding action exists for the call; such an event without action_id observes a call that never went through a decision and is not execution evidence for any action.

attempt_id.description: Decimal string of the native call's attempt number ("1", "2", ...), equal to the coding action's attempt. Required on tool.* events.

payload.description: Type-specific, redacted payload. Metadata only unless content capture was explicitly enabled for the session. Never carries hidden model reasoning. On tool.* events it carries native_request_id, the runtime's id of the call.

allOf.$comment: Tool-call correlation: every tool lifecycle event carries attempt_id and payload.native_request_id.
tool.requested is emitted with the decision, so it always names its coding action.
